resources.description: Text-to-image generation on Venice models (Flux, SD3.5, GPT-Image, HunyuanImage, and more), paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=image and an optional style from GET /api/v1/image/styles.

Text-to-speech on Venice voices (Kokoro, Qwen 3, xAI, Inworld, Chatterbox, Orpheus, ElevenLabs Turbo, MiniMax), paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=tts.

OpenAI-compatible chat on 100+ Venice models via x402 USDC (Base). Model from GET /api/v1/models?type=text; personas via /characters. Thinking models: empty content + reasoning_content is success; use venice_parameters.disable_thinking for plain text.
Text embeddings on Venice models for retrieval, RAG, and semantic search, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=embedding.

Prompt-driven single-image edit on Venice models — send an image plus an instruction and get the edited result, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=image.

OpenAI /v1/images/generations-compatible image generation on Venice image models, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Point any OpenAI image SDK here. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=image.

Async music/audio-track generation on Venice (ACE-Step, ElevenLabs Music, MiniMax, Lyria, Stable Audio), paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Model ids via GET /api/v1/models?type=music. Lifecycle: quote, queue, retrieve, complete (see related routes).

Remove the background from an image and return a transparent PNG, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Venice accepts only `image` (no `model`); optional `model` on the request is used for pricing then stripped before proxy.

Compose or edit using 1-3 input images on Venice models — merge subjects, transfer style, or blend scenes, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=image.
Upscale and enhance an image 2-4x on Venice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Standalone — send an image URL or base64; no model lookup required.
Pay-per-call JSON-RPC proxy to 20+ EVM and Starknet networks on Venice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve the {network} path segment from GET /api/v1/crypto/rpc/networks.
Extract text from PDF/DOCX/XLSX or plain-text documents (up to 25MB) for agent pipelines on Venice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Standalone; no model lookup required.
Scrape and extract clean text/markdown from a public URL for agent pipelines on Venice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Standalone; no model lookup required.
Web search for agent pipelines on Venice — ranked results for a query, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Standalone; no model lookup required.

Speech-to-text transcription on Venice models (Parakeet, Whisper, Wizper, Scribe, xAI STT), paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Multipart upload. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=asr.

Venice Responses API (alpha) — OpenAI-compatible structured agent outputs with typed blocks (reasoning, message, tool calls), paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a model id from GET /api/v1/models?type=text.
Transcribe a YouTube video by URL on Venice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Standalone — send a video URL; no model lookup required.
Voice cloning on Venice — upload a reference sample to mint a reusable voice, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402, no API key. Resolve a compatible TTS model from GET /api/v1/models?type=tts.
